_comment: Deterministic search results for --mock mode (no internet, no API key). Dates are relative (days_ago) so the 'last week' window always works. One result is deliberately 12 days old so the critic's date check has something to catch.

results.title: Automaker begins pilot production of solid-state cells
results.snippet: A pilot line has started producing solid-state battery cells for test vehicles, with volume production targeted later in the decade.

results.title: Researchers report sulfide electrolyte that resists dendrites
results.snippet: A university team describes a sulfide solid electrolyte that survived 1,000 charge cycles without dendrite short circuits in lab cells.

results.title: Battery startup raises funding for solid-state scale-up
results.snippet: A solid-state battery startup closed a new funding round to build a larger manufacturing facility.

results.title: Analysis: why solid-state batteries are still expensive
results.snippet: Analysts say manufacturing yield and materials cost keep solid-state cells far above lithium-ion prices.

results.title: Old announcement: solid-state roadmap unveiled
results.snippet: A roadmap for solid-state batteries was announced at a trade show.
